researcher_notes: 5 files, all marketing/spec web-pages saved as single-page-ish PDFs (Balyo's 'Driven by BALYO' product line, each built on a named OEM base truck per the DB's own base_model_name convention: VEENY=Linde VNA, REACHY=Linde Reach, LOWY/LOWY HD=Linde Stacker, TUGGY=Linde Tractor, LOWY CB=Linde CB). All 5 base models already exist in the DB with every field NULL -- pure enrichment, no new products. 'Veeny_-_VNA_Datasheet_-_11112021.pdf' text-extracts as badly character-duplicated garbage (a font-rendering artifact, not a content issue) -- fell back to visual page-image reading per the 'text first, drawings/images only on demand' rule, since several KO fields (max_payload, lifting_height, min_aisle_width) were unreadable from text alone; the rendered image showed ONE clean visible data table matching the values ultimately used, while pdfplumber's text/table extraction returned FOUR overlapping garbled tables (apparently hidden/leftover text layers from other Balyo product templates reused when this PDF was authored, not actually visible on the page) -- deliberately ignored those hidden layers in favor of what's actually visible on the rendered page. 'LOWY / LOWY HD' is a single combined DB product row, but the two source files (LOWY.pdf, LOWY HD.pdf) describe two datasheets with materially different lift height (2.9m vs 3.0m), aisle width (2.9m vs 2.95m) and overall dimensions -- flagged below as a possible split candidate for the Tech Lead, not acted on unilaterally; conservative (worst-case) values were used for the merged row's KO fields in the meantime.

field_sources.min_aisle_width: CONSERVATIVE (larger/worse-case) value used: base LOWY sheet 'FROM 2.9m/10ft Aisle width'; LOWY HD sheet 'FROM 2950mm/9'8" Aisle width' -- 2950mm (the larger figure) used
field_sources.vehicle_length: base LOWY sheet 'SPECIFICATIONS: Length x width x height ... 2350mm x 811mm x 2327mm / 7'8" x 2'8" x 7'8"' -- taken from the base LOWY sheet, NOT the HD sheet (which lists 2137x800x2337mm instead, not used since this field can only hold one figure per the merged row)
field_sources.battery_type: base LOWY sheet 'Energy & Charging options: Lead Acid / NMC / TPPL'; LOWY HD sheet 'Battery options: Lead Acid / LTO batteries' -- NMC and LTO are both Li-ion chemistries mapped to AP0's 'Li-Ion' allowed value; TPPL (thin-plate pure lead) mapped to 'Lead-Acid'
field_sources.infrastructure_free: base LOWY sheet body text 'BALYO's proprietary infrastructure-free navigation' (applies to both sub-models per shared BALYO platform description)
field_sources.autonomous_charging: base LOWY sheet 'SPECIFICATIONS: ... Autocharge or wireless'

products.notes: FLAG for Tech Lead: source material treats LOWY (base) and LOWY HD as two distinct SKUs with different lift heights (2.9m vs 3.0m), aisle widths (2.9m vs 2.95m) and overall dimensions (2350x811x2327mm vs 2137x800x2337mm) -- the DB currently merges them into one 'LOWY / LOWY HD' product row. Not split here (not this agent's call), but the conservative-value approach used above may understate LOWY HD's actual (higher) lift-height capability or overstate base LOWY's aisle-width requirement if a reviewer later wants per-SKU precision. Recommend considering a split into two Product rows sharing one base model, matching the LOWY CB precedent (already a separate row).
